# Practical Guide to Vehicle Basecamp 12V Auxiliary Power

Reliable auxiliary power is the backbone of any remote basecamp. Powering 12V compressor fridges, diesel heaters, and communications gear requires calculating daily amp-hour consumption and selecting proper battery chemistry.

## Core Component Sizing

### Recommended System Configurations
| Component | Gear / Spec Link | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Auxiliary Battery | [LiFePO4 Deep Cycle 100Ah](https://www.amazon.se/s?k=lifepo4+100ah+12v&tag=basecamprig-21) | Stable daily cycle capacity without voltage sag |
| DC-DC Charger | [50A Dual Battery Charger with MPPT](https://www.amazon.se/s?k=dc+dc+charger+mppt&tag=basecamprig-21) | Regulated alternator charging and solar feed |
| 12V Compressor Fridge | [Heavy Duty Portable Camp Fridge 45L](https://www.amazon.se/s?k=kompressorkylbox+12v&tag=basecamprig-21) | Food preservation with low amp-draw |
| Inverter | [Pure Sine Wave Inverter 1000W](https://www.amazon.se/s?k=ren+sinus+inverter+1000w&tag=basecamprig-21) | Clean 230V power for laptops and tool batteries |

## Daily Consumption Calculation
- **12V Fridge:** 30–45 Ah/day depending on ambient summer temperature.
- **LED Lighting & Device Charging:** 10–15 Ah/day.
- **Diesel Air Heater (Start/Run):** 15–25 Ah/night during shoulder seasons.
